usage: “克” is used as a noun to measure weight, specifically grams.
It usually comes after a number to indicate the quantity, like 50 克 meaning 50 grams.
When using 克 in sentences, it is often followed by the object being measured, e.g., 糖50克 (50 grams of sugar).
In questions or requests, 克 can be used to specify the amount needed.
克 is a standard metric unit, commonly used in recipes, grocery shopping, and weighing small items.
